# Block and tackle (`equipment:block-and-tackle`)
**Categories:** [Adventuring Gear](../equipment-categories/adventuring-gear.md) | **Cost:** 1 gp | **Weight:** 5 lb.

A Block and Tackle allows you to hoist up to four times the weight you can normally lift.
